map.DES / 3DES 加密解密。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开: DES / 3DES Encrypt & Decrypt. An online tool built for developers, running entirely in the front end — your code never leaves the browser.
map.DES / 3DES 分组加密与解密。: Block encryption and decryption with DES or 3DES.
map.：分组 64 位、有效密钥 56 位（含 8 位奇偶校验共 64 位），16 轮: : a 64-bit block, a 56-bit effective key (64 bits including 8 parity bits), and 16 Feistel rounds.
map.：用三组密钥执行 EDE（加密-解密-加密），有效强度约 112 位。: : runs EDE (encrypt–decrypt–encrypt) with three keys for an effective strength of about 112 bits.
map.：ECB 下相同明文块产生相同密文，会泄露图案；应使用 CBC 等带 IV 的模: : under ECB identical plaintext blocks produce identical ciphertext and leak patterns; use a mode with an IV, such as CBC.
map.：DES 已被暴力破解，3DES 亦不推荐使用，新系统应改用 AES。: : DES has been brute-forced and 3DES is no longer recommended; new systems should move to AES.
map.(Data Encryption Standard) 是经典的块加密算法（56位: (Data Encryption Standard) is the classic block cipher with a 56-bit key.
map.(Triple DES / TDEA) 使用三次DES加密，密钥长度112/16: (Triple DES / TDEA) applies DES three times with a 112/168-bit key for greater security.
map.支持 ECB / CBC 模式，PKCS7 填充。⚠️ 建议使用AES代替DES: Supports ECB / CBC modes and PKCS7 padding. ⚠️ Prefer AES over DES for any new encryption.
map.兼容老旧系统或教学分组密码；新系统勿用 DES。: Interop with legacy systems and as a teaching example of a block cipher; do not use DES in new systems.
map.维护老系统时解密历史数据：银行、社保等存量系统里仍有 3DES 加密的记录，需要: Decrypt historical data while maintaining an old system: records encrypted with 3DES still exist in banking, social-security and other legacy systems, and compatibility is needed before they can be migrated.
map.3DES 对明文做 加密→解密→加密（三把 56 位密钥），强度约 112 位；: 3DES applies encrypt → decrypt → encrypt to the plaintext with three 56-bit keys, giving about 112 bits of strength; single DES has already been broken by exhaustive search.
map.56 位密钥空间小，现代算力可数小时穷举。: Its 56-bit key space is small enough for modern hardware to exhaust in a matter of hours.
map.3DES 用三个密钥做三次 DES，有效密钥长度约 112 位，比 56 位的: 3DES runs DES three times with three keys for an effective key length of about 112 bits — far stronger than 56-bit DES, and it served as a stopgap. But its block is only 64 bits, which exposes it to the Sweet32 birthday attack on very large volumes of data, and it is slow. NIST has deprecated it, so new systems should use AES directly.
